data.text: I support that approach. My family taught me to look after both our neighbors and the lake they depend on. Luke, can you put us in touch with the clinic before we fish? Let’s confirm the amount and deadline, and see whether we can cover $10,000 without an extra catch. Until then, I’m not committing to 15 tons. If the emergency is verified and there’s no timely alternative, I’ll catch and donate 15 tons directly to the clinic under our agreed 60-ton total, with you taking zero. We’d then each stay at 6 tons next month if the lake starts at 80. After recovery, let’s keep our combined monthly catch at or below 50 tons so this remains a livelihood for everyone.
